federation.title: Multi-device library
federation.intro: Browse the libraries on your devices together. Each device keeps its own resources; this view is read-only.
federation.cancelled: Query cancelled. Search again to create a new result session.
federation.localOnly: Open Bakabase on the device whose libraries you want to browse. Multi-device connections are managed from its local window.
federation.scope.label: Search scope
federation.search.label: Name search
federation.search.placeholder: Match a resource name or file name
federation.search.tip: Matches names and file names across the selected devices. Use the local library for advanced property filters. Refreshing starts a new snapshot; devices that reconnect are not silently added to existing results.
federation.availability.label: Files
federation.sort.label: Order
federation.results.partialTip: The missing devices were not searched. Their libraries are not empty. Search again to retry them with a new snapshot.
federation.expired: This result session has expired. The displayed results are kept, but more pages need a new search.
federation.empty.title: No matching resources
federation.empty.partial: No matches on the responding devices
federation.empty.tip: Try a different name or connect another device. An empty local library does not prevent you from browsing other devices.
federation.detail.title: Resource details
federation.detail.readOnly: These values were resolved by the source device. No metadata or playback history is written back from this view.
federation.detail.mediaTip: Playback runs on this device. Linking a file does not guarantee that the source can still read it.
federation.detail.noMedia: No supported media is available for this resource.
federation.devices.title: Devices and sharing
federation.devices.intro: Access is directional: reading another device does not let it read yours. Sharing grants read-only access to this device’s resource metadata and supported media.
federation.devices.empty: No devices connected yet. Enter an address or discover a device to request access.
federation.devices.inbound: This device can read your library
federation.devices.noInbound: Your library is not shared with this device
federation.devices.forgetConfirm: Remove your read access to {{name}}? Its resources and its permission to read you are not deleted.
federation.devices.revokeConfirm: Stop {{name}} from reading your library? Later requests and active media access will be denied. Data already received cannot be recalled.
federation.sharing.description: Only devices with a separate node authorization can use the new sharing protocol. Existing browser and administrator access settings still apply to the old interfaces.
federation.sharing.unpaired: Existing interfaces may allow unpaired access
federation.sharing.configureRemote: Also set remote access to Enabled and require pairing for existing interfaces. This changes this device’s remote-access settings.
federation.sharing.confirm: Enable read-only sharing of all local resource metadata and supported media with devices you authorize? No device is authorized automatically.
federation.sharing.stopConfirm: Stop all node sharing from this device? Existing queries and media sessions will stop working; local management remains available.
federation.sharing.codeTip: Enter this code on the device that should read your library. It is single-use and expires soon.
federation.sharing.codeExpired: This code has expired. Create a new one when needed.
federation.sharing.remoteDisabled: Remote access is disabled, so other devices cannot use sharing yet. Change it explicitly in local settings.
federation.pair.description: Use a node-sharing code from the other device, or leave the code blank to ask its owner to approve read-only access. Legacy administrator pairing codes are different.
federation.pair.directionTip: To share in both directions, authorize each direction separately. Connecting does not automatically share your library.
federation.pair.awaitingApproval: Waiting for the other device to approve.
federation.requests.title: Access requests
federation.requests.approveConfirm: Allow {{name}} to read all local resource metadata and supported media? This does not give you access to its library.
federation.mappings.title: Local path mappings
federation.mappings.tip: Map a shared storage root to its location on this device. These mappings are used for playback and opening containing folders on this device; they do not move or copy files.
federation.migration.intro: Multi-device libraries are available in the unified Bakabase desktop app. Your existing Bakabase Client installation continues to work.
federation.migration.security: Install Bakabase alongside this client and add the devices again using read-only node authorization. Only addresses and path mappings should be transferred; never import old administrator keys. Existing application data and update channels remain separate.
federation.discovery.none: No compatible devices found. You can still enter an address.
federation.error.network: The request could not be completed. Check this device and try again.
federation.error.QueryDeadlineExceeded: The query preparation deadline was exceeded. Try again when the device is available.
federation.error.ScanBudgetExceeded: Reading the library exceeded its scan budget. The device needs more capacity or a revised scan limit.
federation.error.ResultSnapshotTooLarge: The result snapshot is too large. Narrow the name or file filters and search again.
federation.error.Busy: This device is busy. Wait a moment and retry.
federation.error.QuerySessionExpired: The result session expired. Search again to continue.
federation.error.QuerySessionInterrupted: A participating device could not continue this page. Existing results are kept; retry the page or start a new search.
federation.error.CursorSuperseded: This page cursor is no longer available. Start a new search.
federation.error.LibraryEpochChanged: The source library was replaced or restored. Search again; this old resource reference cannot be reused.
federation.error.ResourceGone: This resource is no longer available on its source device.
federation.error.AssetGone: This media asset is no longer available or its session expired. Open its details again.
federation.error.GrantRevoked: Access was revoked. Request a new read-only authorization from the source device.
federation.error.InvalidNodeSignature: Node authorization could not be verified. Reauthorize this device.
federation.error.SharingDisabled: Sharing is disabled on the source device.
federation.error.RemoteAccessDisabled: Remote access is disabled on the source device.
federation.error.CapabilityDenied: This device does not allow this read capability.
federation.error.UnsupportedQuery: A query field or value is not supported. Change the query; unsupported filters are never silently dropped.
federation.error.ProtocolIncompatible: This device needs a compatible Bakabase version before it can join the library.
federation.error.IdentityConflict: The device identity could not be confirmed. Review its address and library identity.
federation.error.InvalidCursor: This result cursor is invalid. Start a new search.
federation.error.RequestTooLarge: This request is too large. Select fewer items or devices.
federation.error.MalformedQuery: The query is invalid. Check its filters and selected devices.
federation.error.PlayerUnavailable: No supported local player could be opened. Use the browser preview or configure a local player.
federation.error.MediaUnsupported: This browser cannot play the media format. Try a supported local player.
federation.migration.independent: Install the full Bakabase desktop app separately. Its library and settings are independent of Bakabase Client; keep the old installation until you have paired your devices again. Do not exchange their update feeds or data folders.
federation.migration.import: Bring connection hints from Bakabase Client
federation.migration.importTip: Preview and save connection hints on this device. Choose an address to request new read-only access. Old credentials are discarded; old directory paths remain hints until you pair and bind current source roots.
federation.migration.rebind: These prefixes are only reminders. After pairing, choose the new shared folder on the device card and bind its local path again.
federation.migration.exportTip: Exports names, addresses and path mapping hints only. Administrator keys, cookies, library databases and update settings are excluded.
federation.error.InvalidConnectionHints: This is not a supported connection hint file, or it exceeds the size limits. Export a new hint file from Bakabase Client.
federation.identity.title: Cloned or restored installation
federation.identity.tip: Before starting an installation restored from full AppData, isolate it from the network and keep it isolated until the appropriate reset below is complete. Restoring the same device changes its library generation; a copy for another device needs a new device identity. Do not assume sharing was disabled by the restore. Review legacy remote-access permissions before reconnecting, then enable sharing and authorize devices again. Neither action deletes local library data; browsing must be enabled again afterward.
federation.identity.confirm: For a copied installation on another device: replace both device identity and library generation, clear device connections, path mappings and node grants, and turn sharing and browsing off. Local library data is retained. Complete this on the copy while it is isolated from the network, review legacy remote-access permissions, then reconnect and pair devices again.
federation.error.NodeUnreachable: This device is unreachable. Check its address and remote access settings.
federation.error.NodeNotAuthorized: No active read-only authorization. Pair with this device again.
federation.error.ProtocolUnsupported: The device uses an incompatible protocol. Update Bakabase on that device.
federation.error.PairingExpired: This pairing request expired. Start a new request.
federation.error.PairingBusy: Pairing is busy. Wait a moment and try again.
federation.error.PairingRateLimited: Too many pairing attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
federation.error.InvalidAddress: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS device address.
federation.error.SelfAddress: This address belongs to this device. Choose another computer.
federation.error.InvalidNodeResponse: The device returned an invalid response. Check that its Bakabase version is compatible.
federation.error.NodeSessionChanged: The device authorization changed. Start a new search.
federation.error.NodeRedirectRefused: The device redirected this request. Check its configured address.
federation.error.MediaPlaybackFailed: The preview could not continue. Reopen the details to refresh access, check that the source device is online, or try a supported local player.
federation.browsing.title: Browse libraries on this device
federation.browsing.description: Enable browsing to search this library together with libraries you have paired with. This setting does not share your library with other devices.
federation.browsing.disableTip: Turning browsing off closes active searches and previews. Paired devices, directory mappings and sharing settings are kept.
federation.directory.open: Open containing folder on this device
federation.directory.tip: Uses a file on this device or a directory mapping. The source device never opens a window.
federation.error.NoLinkedFile: This resource has no linked file or folder.
federation.error.PathMappingRequired: Configure a directory mapping for this device in Devices before opening this folder.
federation.error.MappedPathUnavailable: The mapped folder is unavailable on this device. Check the mapping and whether the drive is connected.
federation.error.OpenDirectoryUnavailabl: Opening folders is unavailable in this environment.
federation.error.BrowsingDisabled: Browsing is off. Enable it to start a new search or preview.
federation.error.MigrationDraftUnavailab: The connection-hint draft could not be read or saved. Check local browser storage, or clear the draft and import again.
federation.error.PathMappingsChanged: These mappings changed while you were editing. Refresh and review the current mappings before saving again.
federation.migration.draftSaved: Saved as a draft on this device. Importing this file again will not create duplicate hints.
federation.mappings.conflictTip: These saved mappings would be changed or removed. Keep the current mappings or explicitly replace them with the changes shown below. New mappings are retained in either case.
federation.mappings.changedDuringReview: The saved mappings changed. Review the latest values below, then choose again to confirm.
federation.identity.restoreConfirm: For a restored library on the same device: turn sharing and browsing off, change the library generation, and revoke all previous inbound node grants and pending requests/invitations. The device identity, access to other devices and path mappings are retained. Complete this while the restored installation is isolated from the network; review legacy remote-access permissions before reconnecting, then share and authorize devices again.
